evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/j extends MouseAdapter, owns only one reviewed HotkeyButton, and on left-button mouseReleased assigns the reviewed Keybind.NOT_SET value to that button.
The class has no other event method or unrelated exact-v308 consumer; its complete responsibility is resetting a HotkeyButton binding through the button's existing setter.

proposals.note: HotkeyButtonResetMouseListener is a descriptive exact-behavior name for the anonymous left-click reset adapter. Confidence 0.999.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/k extends KeyAdapter, owns one reviewed HotkeyButton and on keyPressed constructs a Keybind from the KeyEvent then assigns it through the HotkeyButton setter.

The adapter also captures the HotkeyButton constructor's boolean key-capture mode flag; regardless of the optimized branch shape, the only surviving exact-v308 action is capture-and-assign of the pressed key event.

proposals.note: HotkeyButtonKeyCaptureListener is a descriptive exact-behavior name for the anonymous key-capture adapter. It does not assert a verbatim upstream anonymous identifier.
